title: Testes 'reads the real repo-root' de toolchain assertam pin literal e quebram todo bump do Renovate
description: test/config/toolchain.test.ts:51-53 (bun) e ~:64 (node) chamam readPinnedBunVersion()/readPinnedNodeVersion() sem fake injetado e asseram a string literal do pin atual (expect toBe '1.3.13' / '22.23.1'). Consequencia: qualquer bump do Renovate de .bun-version ou .tool-versions muda o arquivo real e quebra a assertion, entao o CI da PR nunca fica verde e o automerge de toolchain-pins que o CAM-201 desenhou (bun-version/asdf) nunca funciona na pratica. Reproduzido ao vivo na PR #173 (bun 1.3.13 -> 1.3.14): 3955 pass, 1 fail exatamente em 'readPinnedBunVersion > reads the real repo-root .bun-version file with default args'. A PR #174 (checkout v7) nao sofre disso (github-actions manager) e ja automergeou. Fix: os dois testes de arquivo-real devem asserir FORMATO (regex semver) em vez do literal, provando resolucao de path + parse sem acoplar a versao concreta; os testes com fake injetado continuam validando valor exato. Casa com CAM-201 (toolchain-parity), CAM-244 (automerge de container) e o objetivo de automerge-all no CI verde.

acceptanceCriteria: The 'reads the real repo-root .bun-version file with default args' test in test/config/toolchain.test.ts no longer asserts a literal version string; it asserts the result is non-null and matches an exact-semver regex (/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/).
The equivalent 'reads the real repo-root .tool-versions file' node test no longer asserts a literal version; it asserts the result is non-null and matches the same exact-semver regex.
All fake-injected tests (readPinnedBunVersion / readPinnedNodeVersion called with an explicit path + reader fn) are left UNCHANGED and keep asserting exact values.
After the change, a Renovate bump of .bun-version or .tool-versions no longer breaks the suite (the real-file tests prove path-resolution + parse, not the concrete version).
typecheck and the full test suite pass green against the current pinned versions.
spec.scope: Decouple the two 'reads the real repo-root' toolchain tests from the concrete pinned version so Renovate toolchain-pin bumps (bun-version, asdf) no longer turn the PR CI red and can automerge as CAM-201 designed. Touch only test/config/toolchain.test.ts. No src change.
gotchas: Only the two default-args (real-file) tests couple to the concrete version; the fake-injected tests (lines ~14-49 bun, ~62-73 node) must stay asserting exact values because a fake string never changes on a Renovate bump.

readPinnedBunVersion already validates exact semver and returns null for ranges/prefixes/'latest' (tests at lines 31-44 prove this), so a /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/ format assertion is consistent with the function's own contract.
Reproduced live on PR #173 (bun 1.3.13 -> 1.3.14): 3955 pass, 1 fail exactly in the bun real-file test; PR #174 (github-actions manager) was unaffected and automerged.
